regions.region: page 1 title, abstract, introduction, and Supporting Information footnote
regions.finding: Article identity and reaction-class claims were reviewed. The footnote only states online availability; source_mapping.json marks SI association unestablished, so no SI facts were imported.

regions.region: page 1 center-right Scheme 1
regions.finding: Generic concept with R1/R2/R3 groups, a magnesium dienolate, and a question-mark protonation arrow; classified as general_scheme rather than a preparative experiment.

regions.region: page 1 lower-right preliminary-results prose continuing to Scheme 2 on page 2
regions.finding: Two distinct 3-equivalent preliminary experiments were identified: CH3MgCl/THF gives 2a in 90% NMR yield and Z/E 3:1; CH3MgBr/Et2O gives Z-2a in 91% NMR yield and Z/E 98:2. They are not merged with the later 1.1-equivalent optimization row.

regions.region: page 1 bottom-right mechanistic discussion continuing to Scheme 3
regions.finding: Solvent-dependent Z-A/E-A isomerization through anti-B/syn-B is presented as an explanation and classified as mechanism, not observed intermediate experiments.

unresolved: Preliminary Scheme 2 runs omit scale, reagent volume, and complete workup/purification.
Scheme 1 and Scheme 3 contain generic or proposed intermediates rather than uniquely isolated species.

regions.region: page 2 upper-left Scheme 2
regions.finding: The original image confirms the two distinct preliminary methyl-Grignard runs, their 3.0 M solution solvents, 3 equivalents, Fe(acac)3 5 mol%, toluene, -78 °C/0.5 h, NH4Cl quench, NMR yields, and Z/E ratios.

regions.region: page 2 center-left Scheme 3
regions.finding: Proposed Z-A/E-A and anti-B/syn-B interconversion diagram; classified as a mechanism and not assigned independent yields.

regions.region: page 2 upper-right Table 1 reaction header, rows 1–10, and footnote a
regions.finding: Ten independent optimization rows were retained with catalyst/loading (including no-catalyst row), reaction solvent, 1.1 equivalents CH3MgBr in Et2O, -78 °C/0.5 h, NMR product yield/Z:E, starting-material recovery, and dibromomethane internal-standard basis. The visually verified values obscured by OCR are >99:1 in entries 2 and 4.

regions.region: page 2 lower-right scope and downstream-transformation prose
regions.finding: Narrative maps to the 19 Table 2 rows and six Scheme 4 arrows on page 3; larger Grignard quantities in entries 7, 12, 13, and 18 are preserved only in their matching rows.

unresolved: Table 1 omits scale, absolute reaction-solvent volume, and post-warming workup/purification.
Narrative descriptions do not add experiment-specific quantities beyond the table/scheme evidence.

regions.region: page 3 upper Scheme 4, six arrows
regions.finding: Six distinct current-paper transformations of Z-2b were retained: n-butanal allylation to E-3, acetylation to E-4, ethoxymethylation to E-5, BF3·2HOAc desilylation to E-6, TBAF/Selectfluor desilylation to Z-7, and Selectfluor fluorination to E-8. Arrow-specific times, temperatures, yields, ratios, and reagents were preserved.

regions.region: page 3 center-left Table 2 reaction header, rows 1–19, and footnotes a–e
regions.finding: Nineteen independent scope experiments were retained row-by-row. Shared 0.6 mmol/5 mL Et2O/Fe(acac)3 2 mol%/-78 °C conditions, Grignard concentrations and equivalents, row times, isolated yields, default >99:1 selectivity, 98:2 and 97:3 overrides, and the distinct 3.6 mmol scale-up were structured.

regions.region: page 3 lower-right General and start of Typical Procedure
regions.finding: Solvent drying and commercial reagent-source statements were treated as general materials context. The exact typical 2a quantities, nitrogen atmosphere, Schlenk setup, -78 °C addition, and 0.5 h time were merged with Table 2 entry 1.

unresolved: Scheme 4 arrows for Z-7 and E-8 omit scale and operational workup on pages 1–6.
Candidate structures do not encode depicted alkene geometry and remain unverified.
General commercial-source text is not an independent experiment.

regions.region: page 4 upper-left completion of Typical Procedure for Z-2a
regions.finding: TLC completion, NH4Cl/water quench, warming, Et2O extraction, sequential HCl/NaHCO3/brine washes, Na2SO4 drying, filtration, concentration, 100:1 chromatography, 135.7 mg, and 93% isolated yield were merged with Table 2 entry 1.

regions.region: page 4 left column preparation of Z-2b and separate 3.6 mmol scale reaction
regions.finding: The 0.6 mmol Z-2b preparation (172.3 mg, 92%) and the distinct 3.6 mmol scale-up (1.0254 g, 92%) were retained as Table 2 entries 2 and 19, not merged by product identity.

regions.region: page 4 remaining preparations Z-2c through Z-2h
regions.finding: Detailed quantities, reagent concentrations, isolated masses/yields, selectivity exceptions, and entry-specific eluents for Table 2 entries 3–8 were merged into their existing table-row records. Spectra were treated as characterization rather than new reactions.

unresolved: The source does not state separate isolated masses for any minor E isomers in the scope runs.
Spectral agreement and successful SMILES parsing do not establish structure correctness.

regions.region: page 5 top-left completion of Z-2h characterization
regions.finding: Characterization completes the cross-page Table 2 entry 8 product description; it does not define a duplicate preparation.

regions.region: page 5 preparations Z-2i through Z-2p
regions.finding: Detailed quantities, Grignard solution volumes/concentrations, catalyst masses/loadings, product masses, yields, Z/E exceptions, and the Z-2l chromatography override were merged with Table 2 entries 9–16. The Z-2p characterization continues onto page 6 without creating another experiment.

unresolved: Minor regio-/stereoisomer masses are not reported.

regions.region: page 6 top-left completion of Z-2p characterization and preparations Z-2q/Z-2r
regions.finding: The cross-page Z-2p characterization was linked to Table 2 entry 16. Exact quantities, solution solvent, masses, times, and isolated yields for Z-2q and Z-2r were merged with entries 17 and 18.

regions.region: page 6 left-column n-butanal allylation to E-3
regions.finding: Detailed 0.4 mmol TiCl4-promoted allylation was merged with Scheme 4: major and minor diastereomers were isolated separately at 58%/7% (71.4/8.7 mg), combined 65%, dr 8:1, with exact workup and chromatography.

regions.region: page 6 right-column acetyl chloride and diethoxymethane transformations
regions.finding: Detailed E-4 (46.7 mg, 84%, E/Z 98:2) and E-5 (58.6 mg, 97%) procedures were merged with their Scheme 4 arrows, retaining the 0.5 h versus 2 h durations and inherited workup for E-5.

regions.region: page 6 lower-right start of BF3·2HOAc desilylation to E-6
regions.finding: The page supplies Z-2b/CH2Cl2/BF3·2HOAc quantities, -20 °C, and 11.5 h; Scheme 4 supplies 96% and E/Z 97:3. The workup continues on page 7 and was not imported into this pages-1–6 record.

unresolved: The E-6 workup, purification, isolated mass, and yield basis lie outside PDF pages 1–6.
E-3 absolute configurations are not assigned on the supplied pages.
No Supporting Information facts were used or inferred.
